title: NoSharp5
description: “The NoSharp5 plugin automatically reduces any sword enchanted with Sharpness V to Sharpness IV. It prevents Sharpness V from being applied or retained, including through anvils and enchantment tables.”
body:
NoSharp5 is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that disables Sharpness V on the server. Any sword or axe with Sharpness 5 will automatically be reduced to Sharpness IV, making Sharp 5 completely unusable.
🔥 Features
Automatically removes Sharpness V
Works on both swords and axes
Keeps PvP balanced and fair
Lightweight and optimized
Supports survival, PvP, and SMP servers
Prevents overpowered Sharp 5 weapons
